1. (1) Peraturan-peraturan ini bolehlah dinamakan Peraturan-Peraturan

Standard Malaysia (Fi) 2018.

(2) Peraturan-Peraturan ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 1 Januari 2019.

Fi

2. (1) Fi berhubung dengan Standard Malaysia hendaklah sebagaimana yang

ditetapkan dalam Jadual Pertama.

(2) Fi berhubung dengan akreditasi hendaklah sebagaimana yang ditetapkan

dalam Jadual Kedua.

(3) Fi yang ditetapkan dalam Peraturan-Peraturan ini hendaklah kena

dibayar kepada Ketua Pengarah.

Penepian

3. Ketua Pengarah boleh mengurangkan atau mengetepikan, sebahagian atau

keseluruhannya, apa-apa fi yang ditetapkan dalam Peraturan-Peraturan ini.

STANDARDS OF MALAYSIA ACT 1996

STANDARDS OF MALAYSIA (FEES) REGULATIONS 2018

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 16(5) and paragraph 22(2)(i) of the

Standards of Malaysia Act 1996 [Act 549], the Minister makes the following regulations:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) These regulations may be cited as the Standards of Malaysia (Fees)

Regulations 2018.

(2) These Regulations come into operation on 1 January 2019.

Fees

2. (1) The fees in relation to a Malaysian Standards shall be as prescribed in the

First Schedule.

(2) The fees in relation to accreditation shall be as prescribed in the

Second Schedule.

(3) The fees prescribed in these Regulations shall be payable to the

Director General.

Waiver

3. The Director General may reduce or waive, partly or wholly, any fees prescribed

in these Regulations.
